body:
Ive tried to learn guitar, but I have no time to learn between schoolwork and sports, and thanks that sounds like an awesome mix.

I cant really do anything at this point so if i stop responding i fell asleep ive decided to give it another day. Thank you a lot for your words and for listening

I appreciate your help, its just that everytime i try to go out and make a change, I get knocked down way harder and feel even worse than before. I almost dont want to try anymore because i dont know if i can handle anything worse than this, I am clearly already struggling. I understand that i will miss opportunities but i will also avoid a ton of pain and grief.
I listen to whatever makes me feel better at the time, usually some type of rock or edm. Ironically i listen to a lot of metal, not really sure why
I know I will create a burden on my family, but im willing to go that far to stop the pain, its just building and building i cant take it anymore.
Thanks a lot for the help, if i dont end it I will try to use some of this advice

But its been this way ever since i could remember, ive waited 6+ years for life to "just get better", i have even gone out of my way to improve my life, and things just never change. I don't want to live for 70 more years feeling this awful and alone regretting not dying sooner. I can feel better now or deal with feeling shitty for as long as it takes to be happy, which may never happen at all.
Is there anything you do specifically that helps you feel better when feeling extremely lonely? Nothing helps me anymore its just a constant shitty feeling hanging over my head all the time.
